text:
Sam (People Ops): Heads-up — draft first-week agenda for managers to run with new hires. Quick ask: please review and flag anything missing. Short version below, full checklist in the HR drive link: https://redwood.ok/first-week-drive :wave:

Sam (People Ops): Day0 (pre-start): account provisioning, hardware + security training, welcome email. Day1: team intros, product overview, setup pairing with buddy. Day2: product deep-dive + shadowing. Day3: infra & dev workflow walkthrough. Day4: team goals, 1:1 with manager, initial 30/60/90 draft. Day5: small contributor task + feedback loop.

Mia (Eng Manager): Thanks — this looks good. Two Qs: 1) Should managers be given a 30/60/90 template to customize? 2) Can we add a short "first shipping" shadow slot on Day5?

Sam (People Ops): Yep to both. I'll attach a editable 30/60/90 template. Adding a 1.5h shadow slot on Day5 makes sense. Mia — want me to pre-fill milestones for your team?

Mia (Eng Manager): If you can pre-fill the org-level bits (OKRs, product priorities) that'd save time. I'll add role-specific goals. :+1:

Alex (DevEx): Rec template for 30/60/90 (short):
```
30 days: ramp, tools, small PRs, learn codebase
60 days: own a component, reduce PR review time, improve a test
90 days: lead a small feature, improve perf by X% or reduce flakiness
```
Use measurable check-ins (PR counts, deploys, latency where applicable).

Raj (IT): For hardware/access: managers — please open an IT ticket with CC to @raj with "New Hire: [name] — equipment" OR use this form: https://redwood.ok/it-newhire. We do same-day provisioning for requests before 10am PST on the start date. For VPN/KMS access we need manager approval in the ticket.

Sam (People Ops): Adding buddy assignment guidance: buddy = peer from same squad, 4-week pairing schedule, daily stand 15m for week1, then twice weekly. Buddy doc link attached.

Mia (Eng Manager): Also adding "Who to escalate to" list would help (oncall, infra, payroll). Could we include a one-slide cheat sheet?

Sam (People Ops): Good call — putting a one-slide "who to ask" card into the welcome packet.

OnboardBot: Calendar invites created: Week1 onboarding block (Mon-Fri, 10:00-12:00 local). Invite links sent to manager and new hire.

Jordan (new-hire): Thanks all! Appreciate the clarity — excited to join next week. Quick q: where do I find the codebase readme?

Alex (DevEx): Welcome! Readme + contributor guide is at https://redwood.ok/dev-guides/repo. I'll DM you a starter PR list and pairing slots.

Mia (Eng Manager): I'll schedule the Day1 1:1 and set expectations (first week: small PR, join product sync). Thanks Sam for drafting this. :heart:

Sam (People Ops): I'll finalize the doc and drop the Drive link here by EOD. If anyone wants to add role-specific checkpoints, comment on the doc. :memo:
